findings.title: Over-session names are not matched to the family being reported
findings.description: `over_sessions` discards each volume check’s family, and `_family_evidence` aggregates names by product across coverage results. `over_failures` then uses that combined list for each family with an `over` count. The failure can therefore name sessions from a different family—or include duplicates—rather than identifying the sessions behind that family’s count. Keep the family with each name and filter names when constructing each failure.

findings.title: Record totals silently omit families missing from the after snapshot
findings.description: `totals_delta` detects families present after but absent before, but not families present before and missing after. Because it iterates only `after`, a family omitted from the accounting output disappears from the reported delta instead of stopping the cutover. Validate that the before and after family-key sets match before calculating deltas.
